name: Collateral Response 3
definition: Provides additional information on the collateral proposal(s), that is either in cash, securities or other types.

SecuritiesCollateralResponse.name: Securities Collateral Response
SecuritiesCollateralResponse.definition: Provides details on the securities collateral proposal.

CashCollateralResponse.name: Cash Collateral Response
CashCollateralResponse.definition: Provides details on the cash collateral proposal.

OtherCollateralResponse.name: Other Collateral Response
OtherCollateralResponse.definition: Provides details on other collateral proposal.

CollateralResponsePresenceRule.definition: CashCollateralResponse or SecuritiesCollateralResponse or OtherCollateralResponse must be present at least once.
